scope: Pizza normal play with fixed updates on the UI thread (direct) and on the simulation worker, and the worker presenting every tick against presenting only newly published frames.
switch: On by default; SPACEWARS_PIZZA_SIMULATION_WORKER=0 returns updates to the UI thread. tools/pizza-live-capture.sh sets it from its ninth argument, worker (default) or direct.

worker.purpose: worker against direct; this intermediate state defaulted to direct and presented every tick

commits.note: The committed files match files_sha256, the source of the fresh build.

builds.note: No code changed during or after either build.

device.model: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B Rev 1.4 (Picade), Linux 6.6.63-v8, ondemand governor
device.installed_image: 5b420c95b87b, untouched; the kiosk was restored after every capture and the lab service was inactive afterwards
device.arguments: 500 balls, limit 500, 1,200 ordinary updates and 30 one-second intervals; the script fixes seed 7; one capture at a time with a 30 s pause between captures

worker_against_direct.temperature_c: capture boundaries 65.2 to 71.1; pre-export samples at most 72.5; firmware throttling flags zero in every sample

presentation.binary: every: worker build; fresh: fresh build; both run the worker
presentation.temperature_c: capture boundaries 61.8 to 68.7; pre-export samples at most 70.6; firmware throttling flags zero in every sample
presentation.command: python3 tools/pizza-worker-summary.py WORKER_ARCHIVE/pi-present --pair every fresh --desktop GRAVITY_ARCHIVE/extracts

matching.replay_key: ordered state fingerprint after every update
matching.pi_pairs: each pair in both experiments produces identical fingerprints at all 1,200 updates
matching.pi_against_desktop: all twelve runs replay the bounded-gravity desktop seed-7 extracts in pizza-gravity-20261018-raw.tar.gz
matching.desktop_end_to_end: the same desktop ci-profile client under Xvfb, default window, produces identical fingerprints at all 1,200 lab updates with and without the worker; only the worker run has a pizza-simulation thread
matching.mode_check: the summary confirms each run's requested mode from the client's status report

validation.worker_tests: seven worker unit tests (direct-stepping equivalence with queued pointer and event input over 240 updates, paused commands, frame publication, pause at an update boundary, catch-up and backlog drop, failure reporting) and two host tests (input, trigger, pause and restart through the host; presenting each frame once per viewport)
validation.pizza_ui_flows: launcher, event-controls and event-completion flows pass with the worker by default and with SPACEWARS_PIZZA_SIMULATION_WORKER=0
validation.clippy: no findings in touched code; the engine-client crate has pre-existing findings elsewhere
validation.capture_script: shellcheck reports only its pre-existing SC2024 note

archive.contents: Both Pi 4 experiments (pi/ and pi-present/, six production captures each, with boundary readings and device file hashes), the desktop end-to-end reports, statuses and thread lists under desktop/, and SHA256SUMS. Binaries, per-run temporary config directories and control sockets are excluded.
